name: LocalSend
taskLabel: Share files between nearby devices
summary: Share files and messages between nearby devices over your local network.
description: LocalSend is a free, open-source cross-platform app that allows you to share files and messages with nearby devices over your local Wi-Fi network without an internet connection or external servers.

name: NAPS2
taskLabel: Scan documents and recognize text
summary: Scan documents to PDF and images with WIA/TWAIN/ESCL and built-in OCR.
description: NAPS2 (Not Another PDF Scanner) lets you scan documents with a single click, rotate/crop/rearrange pages, and run optical character recognition (OCR) in over 100 languages.

name: PDF Arranger
taskLabel: Merge, split and rearrange PDF pages
summary: Merge, split, rotate, crop and rearrange pages of PDF documents.
description: PDF Arranger is a small graphical application that helps you merge or split PDF documents and rotate, crop and rearrange their pages using an interactive visual interface.

name: SumatraPDF
taskLabel: Read PDFs and ebooks with a focused viewer
summary: Fast, lightweight reader for PDF, ePub, MOBI, CBZ, CBR, DjVu and XPS.
description: SumatraPDF is a fast, small, and focused document viewer for Windows supporting PDF, eBooks (ePub, Mobi), comic books (CBZ/CBR), DjVu, XPS, and CHM files.

name: LibreOffice
taskLabel: Write documents, spreadsheets and presentations
summary: Full-featured office suite for word processing, spreadsheets, and presentations.
description: LibreOffice includes Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Math and Base, supporting OpenDocument (ODF) and Microsoft Office formats offline.

name: KeePassXC
taskLabel: Keep passwords in an offline encrypted database
summary: Store and manage passwords securely in an offline encrypted database.
description: KeePassXC is a community-driven port of Keepass Password Safe, storing your passwords, TOTP tokens, and passkeys in an industry-standard KDBX encrypted database on your PC.

name: MusicBrainz Picard
taskLabel: Identify and organize music metadata
summary: Identify, tag and organize audio files using the MusicBrainz database.
description: MusicBrainz Picard is a cross-platform music tagger that uses AcoustID audio fingerprints and release-oriented tagging to keep your music collection organized.

name: calibre
taskLabel: Organize, read and convert ebooks
summary: Organize, read, edit and convert your ebook library across formats.
description: calibre is a comprehensive e-book library manager, viewer, editor, and format converter supporting EPUB, AZW3, MOBI, PDF, and dozens of e-reader devices.

name: Flow Launcher
taskLabel: Find and launch apps using the keyboard
summary: Quick file search and app launcher for Windows with community plugins.
description: Flow Launcher lets you search applications, files, bookmarks, calculator expressions, and system commands instantly from your keyboard.

name: ScreenToGif
taskLabel: Record short screen clips and edit GIFs
summary: Record your screen, webcam or sketchboard and edit frame-by-frame GIFs.
description: ScreenToGif combines a lightweight screen, webcam, and whiteboard recorder with a built-in frame editor for exporting GIF, APNG, WebP, and video clips.

name: ShareX
taskLabel: Capture, annotate and share screenshots
summary: Capture any area of your screen, annotate images, and automate workflows.
description: ShareX is a powerful screen capture, image annotation, color picker, and productivity tool for Windows with customizable hotkeys and post-capture workflows.

name: Notepad++
taskLabel: Edit plain text and code
summary: Fast plain-text and source-code editor for Windows with syntax highlighting.
description: Notepad++ is a free source code editor and Notepad replacement that supports dozens of programming languages, multi-document tabs, regular expression search, and low CPU usage.

name: WinMerge
taskLabel: Compare and merge files or folders
summary: Visual differencing and merging tool for both files and directories.
description: WinMerge compares folders and files, presenting differences in a visual text/image/table format that is easy to understand and merge.

name: draw.io Desktop
taskLabel: Draw flowcharts and diagrams offline
summary: Create flowcharts, network diagrams, UML and architecture charts offline.
description: draw.io Desktop is the official offline diagramming application built on diagrams.net, designed for local file storage with zero external cloud dependencies.

name: Krita
taskLabel: Paint and illustrate with a graphics tablet
summary: Professional digital painting, concept art, illustration and 2D animation studio.
description: Krita is a professional FREE and open source painting program made by artists for concept art, texture and matte painters, illustrations, comics, and frame-by-frame 2D animation.

name: Inkscape
taskLabel: Create vector illustrations, logos and SVGs
summary: Create and edit scalable vector graphics (SVG), illustrations, and logos.
description: Inkscape is a professional vector graphics editor for Windows with flexible drawing tools, node editing, boolean operations, bitmap tracing, and native W3C SVG support.

name: GIMP
taskLabel: Retouch photos and compose layered images
summary: Retouch photos, compose layered images, and design graphics.
description: GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program) provides high-quality tools for photo retouching, image composition, and graphic design with non-destructive layer effects.

name: Blender
taskLabel: Create 3D models, animation and renders
summary: 3D creation suite for modeling, sculpting, rigging, animation and rendering.
description: Blender is the free and open source 3D creation suite supporting the entirety of the 3D pipeline—modeling, rigging, animation, simulation, rendering, compositing and motion tracking.

name: darktable
taskLabel: Organize photos and develop RAW images
summary: Virtual lighttable and darkroom for photographers managing RAW negatives.
description: darktable is an open source photography workflow application and non-destructive raw developer that manages your digital negatives in a database and lets you view and develop them.

name: RawTherapee
taskLabel: Develop RAW photos with detailed controls
summary: Non-destructive RAW photo development with advanced color and detail controls.
description: RawTherapee is a powerful cross-platform raw photo processing system with high-precision demosaicing, color management, and batch processing tools.

name: OBS Studio
taskLabel: Record the screen and stream live video
summary: Record your screen, mix audio/video sources, and stream live video.
description: OBS Studio is free and open source software for video recording and live streaming, featuring high-performance real-time video/audio capturing and scene composition.

name: Shotcut
taskLabel: Edit videos on a multitrack timeline
summary: Edit videos on a multitrack timeline with wide format support.
description: Shotcut is a free, open source, cross-platform video editor supporting hundreds of audio and video formats natively without import transcoding.

name: Kdenlive
taskLabel: Edit longer videos with effects and titles
summary: Non-linear video editor with multi-track editing, effects, transitions and titles.
description: Kdenlive is a powerful open-source video editor built on MLT and KDE frameworks, offering configurable workspaces, keyframeable effects, audio scopes, and proxy editing.

name: Audacity
taskLabel: Record, trim and edit audio
summary: Multi-track audio editor and recorder for podcasts, voice and music.
description: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows with live microphone recording, spectrogram analysis, and effect plugins.

name: VLC media player
taskLabel: Play local videos, audio and streams
summary: Play almost any video, audio file, disc or network stream without extra codec packs.
description: VLC is a free and open source cross-platform multimedia player and framework that plays most multimedia files as well as DVDs, Audio CDs, VCDs, and various streaming protocols.

name: FreeCAD
taskLabel: Design parametric parts and 3D-printable objects
summary: Parametric 3D CAD modeler for mechanical engineering, product design and 3D printing.
description: FreeCAD is a general-purpose parametric 3D computer-aided design (CAD) modeler and building information modeling (BIM) software application with finite element method (FEM) support.

name: 7-Zip
taskLabel: Compress and extract file archives
summary: High-compression file archiver supporting 7z, ZIP, RAR, TAR, GZIP, and ISO.
description: 7-Zip is a file archiver with a high compression ratio using LZMA and LZMA2 compression, supporting packing and unpacking of 7z, XZ, BZIP2, GZIP, TAR, ZIP, and WIM archives and unpacking of RAR, ISO, VHD, and NSIS.

name: PeaZip
taskLabel: Browse, encrypt and convert archives
summary: Graphical archive manager supporting over 200 archive formats and strong encryption.
description: PeaZip is a free file archiver utility and RAR extractor for Windows that works with 200+ archive types and variants (7z, arc, brotli, bz2, gz, iso, pea, rar, tar, udf, zip, zpaq, zstd) and features two-factor authentication and encrypted password manager.

name: Microsoft PowerToys
taskLabel: Customize Windows window layouts and shortcuts
summary: Set of utilities for power users to tune and streamline their Windows experience.
description: Microsoft PowerToys is a set of open-source utilities for Windows including FancyZones window manager, PowerToys Run launcher, Color Picker, Awake, Image Resizer, File Locksmith, Text Extractor, and Advanced Paste.

name: Files
taskLabel: Organize files with tabs, columns and tags
summary: Modern file manager for Windows with multiple tabs, dual-pane view, column view, and file tags.
description: Files is a modern file explorer built for Windows featuring multi-tab navigation, dual-pane views, Miller columns, color-coded tags, cloud drive integration, and archive inspection.

name: BleachBit
taskLabel: Free disk space and clean application caches
summary: Free disk space, clear temporary caches, and maintain privacy on Windows.
description: BleachBit quickly frees disk space and guards your privacy by cleaning cache, cookies, temporary files, and logs across browsers and hundreds of Windows applications.

name: Rufus
taskLabel: Create bootable USB drives from ISO images
summary: Format and create bootable USB flash drives from Windows and Linux ISOs.
description: Rufus is a small utility that helps format and create bootable USB flash drives, such as USB keys, pendrives, and memory sticks, for installing operating systems or running low-level utilities.

name: balenaEtcher
taskLabel: Flash OS images to SD cards and USB drives
summary: Flash OS images to SD cards and USB drives safely with validated writes.
description: balenaEtcher is a cross-platform tool for flashing OS images to SD cards and USB drives with automatic drive selection protection and post-write verification.

name: Syncthing
taskLabel: Synchronize folders continuously across devices
summary: Continuous, private peer-to-peer file synchronization between your computers.
description: Syncthing replaces proprietary sync and cloud services with open, trustworthy, and decentralized peer-to-peer file synchronization directly between your devices.

name: Logseq
taskLabel: Build a local Markdown knowledge base and daily journal
summary: Privacy-first, local-Markdown knowledge base, outliner, and task manager.
description: Logseq is a privacy-first knowledge management and collaboration platform that works on top of plain-text Markdown and Org-mode files stored right on your computer.

name: Joplin
taskLabel: Take Markdown notes and sync with end-to-end encryption
summary: Open-source Markdown note-taking and to-do application with encrypted sync.
description: Joplin is an open-source note-taking and to-do application that handles thousands of Markdown notes organized into notebooks, with support for attachments, web clipping, and end-to-end encryption.

name: AppFlowy
taskLabel: Manage docs, wikis, kanban boards and tables locally
summary: Open-source workspace for notes, wikis, projects, and databases where you stay in control of your data.
description: AppFlowy is an AI-ready, offline-first collaborative workspace for notes, wikis, projects, kanban boards, and databases built with Flutter and Rust.

name: Zettlr
taskLabel: Write Markdown articles with citations and Zettelkasten links
summary: Markdown editor tailored for researchers, journalists, and academic writing with citations.
description: Zettlr is a Markdown editor designed for academic writing, journalism, and Zettelkasten note-taking with native Zotero/BibTeX citation integration and Pandoc export.

name: Okular
taskLabel: Annotate, highlight and sign PDF documents
summary: Universal document viewer from KDE with rich PDF annotations and digital signatures.
description: Okular is KDE's universal document viewer supporting PDF, EPUB, DjVu, Markdown, and comic books with inline highlights, sticky notes, freehand drawing, and digital signature verification.

name: Scribus
taskLabel: Design print-ready magazines, books and brochures
summary: Professional desktop publishing (DTP) and page layout for print-ready PDFs.
description: Scribus is an open-source page layout program that produces commercial-grade output in PDF and Postscript with CMYK color, spot colors, ICC color management, and pre-press tools.

name: HandBrake
taskLabel: Convert and compress videos for modern devices
summary: Open-source video transcoder for converting video from nearly any format to modern codecs.
description: HandBrake is a multi-threaded video transcoder supporting AV1, HEVC (H.265), H.264, VP9, hardware encoding (NVENC, QSV, VCE), batch queuing, chapter markers, and subtitles.

name: mpv.net
taskLabel: Watch high-bitrate video with GPU shader scaling
summary: Modern Windows media player built on libmpv with a customizable native context menu.
description: mpv.net is a modern media player for Windows that combines libmpv's high-quality video output and hardware decoding with a native Windows GUI, context menu, and input editor.

name: LosslessCut
taskLabel: Trim and cut video and audio without re-encoding
summary: The Swiss Army knife of lossless video and audio trimming and cutting.
description: LosslessCut lets you quickly extract the good parts from large video and audio files without slow re-encoding or quality loss, powered by FFmpeg.

name: Tenacity
taskLabel: Record and edit multi-track audio with zero telemetry
summary: Community-driven multi-track audio editor and recorder with zero telemetry.
description: Tenacity is an easy-to-use, privacy-respecting multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows supporting VST, LV2, LADSPA, and Nyquist plugins.

name: MuseScore Studio
taskLabel: Write, play back and print sheet music scores
summary: Professional music notation, score composition, and realistic instrument playback.
description: MuseScore Studio is the world's most popular open-source music notation software, supporting MIDI input, MusicXML import/export, tablature, and orchestra playback.

name: LMMS
taskLabel: Compose beats, melodies and synthesizer tracks
summary: Cross-platform digital audio workstation (DAW) for beat creation, synthesizers, and mixing.
description: LMMS lets you produce music with your computer by creating melodies and beats, synthesizing and mixing sounds, and arranging samples with built-in instruments and VST support.

name: digiKam
taskLabel: Organize large photo libraries and tag faces
summary: Advanced digital photo management, facial recognition organizer, and RAW editor.
description: digiKam is an advanced open-source digital photo management application that makes importing, organizing, deduplicating, and editing large collections of digital and RAW photos fast and reliable.

name: ImageGlass
taskLabel: View WebP, SVG, HEIC, PSD and RAW images quickly
summary: Lightweight, versatile image viewer supporting 80+ formats including WebP, SVG, HEIC, and PSD.
description: ImageGlass is a lightweight, versatile image viewer designed to take the place of Photo Viewer in Windows, supporting over 80 common and specialist image formats.

name: Pencil2D
taskLabel: Create 2D hand-drawn bitmap and vector animations
summary: Intuitive 2D hand-drawn animation software with bitmap and vector workflows.
description: Pencil2D is a simple, intuitive tool to make 2D hand-drawn animations using both bitmap and vector graphics with onion skinning and timeline soundtracks.

name: Dust3D
taskLabel: Model watertight 3D game assets with auto-rigging
summary: Quick 3D watertight modeling and auto-rigging tool for game assets and 3D printing.
description: Dust3D is a cross-platform open-source 3D modeling software that helps you create watertight 3D models in seconds with automatic UV unwrapping, PBR materials, and skeletal rigging.

name: Visual Studio Code
taskLabel: Write, refactor and debug code across languages
summary: Extensible code editor with built-in Git, debugging, terminal, and language intelligence.
description: Visual Studio Code is a lightweight but powerful source code editor for Windows with built-in support for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js, integrated Git control, debugging, and a rich ecosystem of extensions for C++, C#, Python, Rust, and Go.

name: Godot Engine
taskLabel: Develop 2D and 3D games with a scene-tree engine
summary: Feature-packed, cross-platform open-source game engine for 2D and 3D games.
description: Godot Engine provides a huge set of common tools for developing 2D and 3D games through a unified interface, node-and-scene architecture, GDScript, C#, and GDExtension.

name: Tiled
taskLabel: Design orthogonal, isometric and hexagonal game levels
summary: Flexible 2D level and tilemap editor for orthogonal, isometric, and hexagonal games.
description: Tiled is a 2D level editor that helps you develop the content of your game with tile layers, object layers, custom properties, auto-mapping rules, and export plugins.

name: Git for Windows
taskLabel: Manage source code repositories with Git Bash and GUI
summary: Distributed version control system with Git Bash, Git GUI, and credential manager.
description: Git for Windows brings the full feature set of the Git SCM to Windows while providing native Git Bash, Git GUI, shell integration, and Git Credential Manager.

name: DB Browser for SQLite
taskLabel: Create, design and query SQLite database files
summary: Visual tool to create, design, browse, and edit database files compatible with SQLite.
description: DB Browser for SQLite (DB4S) is a high quality, visual, open-source tool to create, design, and edit SQLite database files using a familiar spreadsheet-like interface and SQL query runner.

name: Bruno
taskLabel: Test REST and GraphQL APIs with Git-friendly collections
summary: Fast, offline-first, Git-friendly open-source API client for REST and GraphQL.
description: Bruno is a fast and Git-friendly open-source API client that stores your API collections directly in plain-text folders on your filesystem with zero cloud lock-in.

name: Wireshark
taskLabel: Capture and analyze network traffic protocols
summary: The world's foremost network protocol analyzer and packet inspection tool.
description: Wireshark lets you capture and interactively browse the traffic running on a computer network with deep inspection of hundreds of protocols and rich display filters.

name: Bitwarden
taskLabel: Manage passwords and passkeys across devices
summary: Open-source password, passkey, and secrets manager for Windows.
description: Bitwarden is an open-source password manager that stores sensitive information such as website credentials, passkeys, and secure notes in an encrypted vault with Windows Hello support.

name: Cryptomator
taskLabel: Encrypt files locally before syncing to cloud drives
summary: Client-side AES-256 encryption for your cloud storage folders (OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive).
description: Cryptomator encrypts your data quickly and easily on your PC before you upload it to any cloud service, mounting encrypted vaults as virtual drives in Windows Explorer.

name: Mozilla Thunderbird
taskLabel: Manage email accounts, calendars, contacts and RSS feeds
summary: Full-featured open-source email, calendar, contacts, and RSS client.
description: Thunderbird is a free open-source email, newsfeed, chat, and calendar client that makes managing multiple email accounts fast, private, and customizable.

name: qBittorrent
taskLabel: Download and seed BitTorrent files with RSS and search
summary: Clean, lightweight, ad-free BitTorrent client built with C++ and Qt.
description: qBittorrent is a lightweight, open-source BitTorrent client featuring an integrated extensible search engine, RSS feed support, sequential downloading, and IP filtering.
